title: Question order with singular owners
focus: Begin with Onko, place the owner immediately after it, and put the thing last: Onko sinulla pallo?

exercises.prompt: Build “Do you have a pen?” Put the owner immediately after the question word. Use sinulla (“you as the owner”) and kynä (“a pen”). Address one person.
exercises.explanation: Follow the pattern: onko + possessor + one thing in its basic singular form.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Possession question word order: form or meaning confused

sentenceExplanation.pattern: onko + possessor + one thing in its basic singular form

parts.formation: On + the yes/no question ending -ko = onko. It stays the same with every possessor.

parts.role: possessor: the person who has the thing
parts.formation: sinä has the learned possession form sinulla; its -lla/-llä ending marks the possessor. Learn this pronoun form as a whole.
kynä stays in its basic singular form: one pen.
